units: Jud. V, 11) [distributor, cmp. בָּזִיךְ,] ladle for filling vessels out of the well, or the wine- or oil-pit.
<cite ref="Mishnah Parah 5:5">Par. V, 5</cite> <he>שולי המ׳</he> the sides of a broken ladle.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 74b">Ab. Zar. 74ᵇ</cite>; Y. ib. V, end, 45ᵇ; <cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 8:1">Tosef. ib. VIII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 9:1">IX</cite>), 1.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 10:7">Toh. X, 7</cite> <he>אם היה זולף מ׳</he> if he emptied the pit by using a ladle (to pour into the vessels).—Pl. <he>מַחֲצִין</he>.
Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. VII, 15.—[Fl. to Levy Talm. Dict. III, 309ᵃ: מָחָץ, fr. מחץ to stir, cmp.
